english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone drunk and staggering from alcohol.
Use this when describing someone who is visibly drunk or inebriated.

examples.english: After a few beers, they were rolling drunk on the way home.
examples.traditional: 佢飲完幾杯啤酒，醉醺醺咁行返屋企。

examples.english: They came home after drinking, completely battered.
